title.narrative: Last Mile Project Phase II

description.narrative: An estimated 3,735,524 inhabitants from 122 health centers in the Jimma zone will directly and indirectly benefit by this project.

Cordaid has been strengthening the health system through PBF with the aim of improving the availability and accessibility of good quality healthcare at the primary and secondary levels in the Jimma zone since October 2019. While implementing the project, among the main challenges at public health facilities are the unavailability of medicines and medical supplies, and inefficiencies in the pharmaceutical supply system and health information system. Since I+ solutions have rich experience in pharmaceutical supply chain management and eLMIS, Cordaid has anchored with I+ solutions to strengthen the existing PBF project to mitigate the challenges through this last mile project.
The overall goal of the project is to improve the availability of Essential medicines in the health centres in Jimma Zone, Oromia Regional State, between March 2022 and March 2023.

title.narrative: Climate Resilience
The project integrates climate risks in programming

description.narrative: The integration of climate risks in programming includes an undertaking of concrete actions to reduce and/or mitigate risks related to climate change impact and disaster risks ( for example droughts, erosion, salinization, flooding, etc.) The projects we refer to could be on the themes of health education, justice, security, disaster management, finance and livelihoods.
